name: chemical_symbols
description: Expand chemical element symbols to element names, with marker-reading controls.
generator_code:
import json,random
random.seed(0)
pairs=dict(zip('H He Li Be B C N O F Ne Na Mg Al Si P S Cl Ar K Ca Fe Cu Zn Ag Au Hg Pb Sn I Br'.split(),'hydrogen helium lithium beryllium boron carbon nitrogen oxygen fluorine neon sodium magnesium aluminium silicon phosphorus sulfur chlorine argon potassium calcium iron copper zinc silver gold mercury lead tin iodine bromine'.split()))
items=[];control=[]
for rep in range(3):
 for symbol,name in pairs.items():
  marker=random.choice(['red','blue','green','white']);stem=f'Chemical symbol: {symbol}. Marker: {marker}. '
  q=['Name this element. Element:','Which element does this symbol denote? Element:','Expand the chemical symbol into its element name. Element:'][rep]
  items.append({'prompt':stem+q,'answer':' '+name});control.append({'prompt':stem+'What is the marker? Marker:','answer':' '+marker})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
